title: 36 Hours in the Berkshires
abstract: Do you prefer nature or culture? Indulging in local food or burning it off? Choose your own combination during a weekend in western Massachusetts.

title: 36 Hours in Graz, Austria
abstract: The country’s second-largest city, built around an ancient hilltop castle, boasts rich design, art and culinary scenes.

title: 36 Hours in Dakar, Senegal
abstract: Browse markets and take in some live music, sip a cocktail with a view and take a boat to an island during a weekend in this West African city.

title: 36 Hours in Provincetown, Mass.
abstract: From seaside strolls to dance parties, street performances to gallery exhibits, you can find it all during a weekend on the tip of Cape Cod.

title: 36 Hours in Green Bay, Wis.
abstract: There’s more to this town of 100,000 than just the Packers. Green Bay boasts everything from craft beer to a postcard-perfect amusement park to the National Railroad Museum.
